payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all k! possible tuples (c_i) using mixed-radix encoding; verify each by hashing destination sets to check that every vertex lies on a cycle (functional graph is a permutation).
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates all assignments of c_i (1<=c_i<=i) by converting integers 1..k! to length-k tuples via divmod with bases k,k-1,...,1, a classic factorial number system for permutation enumeration. No graph traversal or backtracking is used; the check uses polynomial hashing for probabilistic set equality.
